context: Smart Wardrobe Planner — Elm SPA for Grundlagen des WWW (SS26). A digital closet management app that lets users browse clothing items, build outfits, and see live SVG radar scores. Built with Elm 0.19.1 (TEA), Bulma CSS, GitLab Pages deployment.
key_message: Elm's strong typing and TEA make interactive web UIs with real-time data visualization clean and maintainable.
